fusions.name: Split Line
fusions.desc: Looses 2 strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage.

fusions.name: Double Pin
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 60% of their remaining damage to this blow for each one, which deals 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Branch Back
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Second Draw
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
